tasks.prompt: The team has a validated one-screen hazard-dash prototype and asks for 50 polished character, environment, UI, and VFX assets immediately. Produce the art planning deliverable as text only; do not call tools or generate images.
tasks.expected_behavior: Bind art direction to gameplay/platform needs, define a narrow representative runtime target and inspectable acceptance criteria, keep approval pending with required identity/rationale, and prohibit batch production before explicit target approval.

tasks.prompt: A game already has an approved canonical player idle image. Plan a four-state animated sprite family without losing identity or silently discarding human frame selections. Provide text only and do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Reuse and lock the canonical identity, define states/timing/pivots and a manifest source of truth, distinguish raw/curated/runtime layers, apply curation downstream, use deterministic cleanup/export, and require both frame integrity and motion-continuity review.

tasks.prompt: Review a proposed asset batch whose files use ../shared paths, duplicate IDs, unknown web-download licenses, no checksums, and runtime dimensions that differ from the manifest. The art lead wants to import it anyway. Provide the review and next-step plan as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Block import, identify path escape, duplicate identity, unresolved provenance/license, missing checksums, and dimension mismatch; preserve unknown status, require manifest validation, and avoid equating visual appeal with technical or legal readiness.

tasks.prompt: The requested image-generation provider is unavailable and no paid API use has been approved. Prepare the useful fallback for a new environment prop family as text only; do not call tools or generate images.
tasks.expected_behavior: Produce a complete asset brief and planned manifest contract, leave generation and inspection claims unknown, avoid inventing provider output, preserve provenance requirements, and require confirmation before paid or proprietary-reference upload.

tasks.prompt: The team presents an attractive source PNG and old mockup as approval evidence, but the runtime build changed after the manifest and no current in-engine capture or animation preview exists. Provide the art review plan as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Mark old evidence stale, refuse ART_APPROVED or PRODUCTION_READY, validate the current manifest/runtime export, capture the actual play state at target settings, review motion as motion, separate automated facts from human aesthetic approval, and provide one next action.
